title: fix: add `"output": "static"` to web config to resolve Render 404
body:
`expo export -p web` with Expo Router requires `web.output: "static"` in `app.json` to emit a populated `dist/` with `index.html`. Without it, the export produces an incomplete output directory and Render serves 404 on all routes.

## Change

- **`mobile/app.json`** — added `"output": "static"` to the `web` config:

```json
"web": {
  "favicon": "./assets/favicon.png",
  "bundler": "metro",
  "output": "static"
}
```

The `render.yaml` SPA rewrite (`/* → /index.html`) was already correct and requires no changes.

<summary>Original prompt</summary>

> ## Problem
> 
> Deploying the Expo web app to Render results in a **404 Not Found** error. The root cause is that `mobile/app.json` is missing `"output": "static"` in the `web` config.
> 
> The `render.yaml` builds the static site with:
> ```
> expo export -p web
> ```
> 
> With Expo Router, this command requires `web.output` to be `"static"` in `app.json`. Without it, Expo Router does not generate proper static HTML files, so the `dist/` folder either won't contain an `index.html` or will be incomplete — causing Render to return 404.
> 
> ## Fix
> 
> In `mobile/app.json`, update the `web` section to add `"output": "static"`:
> 
> ```json
> "web": {
>   "favicon": "./assets/favicon.png",
>   "bundler": "metro",
>   "output": "static"
> }
> ```
> 
> No other changes are needed. The `render.yaml` already has the correct SPA rewrite rule (`/* → /index.html`) for client-side routing.
> 
> The following is the prior conversation context from the user's chat exploration (may be truncated):

> Assistant: The 404 is caused by a missing `"output": "static"` in your `app.json` web config.
> 
> ## Root Cause
> 
> In your `render.yaml`, the static site build runs:
> ```
> expo export -p web
> ```
> 
> With **Expo Router**, this command requires `web.output` to be set to `"static"` in `app.json`. Without it, Expo Router doesn't generate proper static HTML files, so the `dist/` folder either won't contain an `index.html` or will be empty — causing Render to return **404 Not Found**.
> 
> ## Fix
> 
> Update `mobile/app.json` — add `"output": "static"` to the `web` section:
> 
> ```json name=mobile/app.json url=https://github.com/DiniMuhd7/lifegate-mobile-app/blob/eba17fc5cdf01bcdd91e952d64bb25b276ab4e69/mobile/app.json#L9-L12
> "web": {
>   "favicon": "./assets/favicon.png",
>   "bundler": "metro",
>   "output": "static"
> }
> ```
> 
> ## Why This Works
> 
> | Without `output: "static"` | With `output: "static"` |
> |---|---|
> | Expo Router doesn't generate static HTML per-route | Each route gets a pre-rendered `index.html` |
> | `dist/` may be empty or missing `index.html` | `dist/index.html` exists → Render serves it correctly |
> 
> ## Other Things to Check
> 
> Your `render.yaml` already has the correct SPA rewrite rule:
> ```yaml
> routes:
>   - type: rewrite
>     source: /*
>     destination: /index.html
> ```
> That's good — this handles client-side routing after the initial page loads.
> 
> **After adding `"output": "static"`**, re-deploy on Render and the 404 should be resolved.
